The final implementation is tested on the established GFRN signature dataset
and NASA GeneLab liver collection. The scripts preserve the accepted sample
definitions and exclude the GLDS-168 NASA stratum.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
system("Rscript validation/run_all.R")
metrics <- read.delim("validation/real_data_metrics.tsv")
metrics
```

| Dataset | Conditional batch R2 | Mean-alignment RMSE | Descriptive residual logCPM variance alignment |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| GFRN | 0.03111 | 0.08128 | 0.17773 |
| NASA GeneLab | 0.10079 | 0.19178 | 0.09293 |

`validation/run_all.R` checks these regression anchors directly against the TSV
output. Reference counts are exactly invariant in both datasets, and the TSV
also records retained samples/genes, outcomes, reference batch, and
transformation magnitude.

These quantities describe empirical batch alignment. Residual logCPM variance
alignment is not negative-binomial dispersion, and neither dataset supplies a
uniform biological ground truth for all retained batches.
